title: Server-side siteverify with the always-fail secret returns success false, the handler rejects 400, refusal body carries error-codes and no sitekey
asA: shelf consumer whose Worker fails safe on every Turnstile refusal
iWant: a POST to siteverify with the pinned always-fail secret to return success:false, the handler to reject with 400, and the refusal body to carry the documented error-codes value and never the sitekey
soThat: every failure branch produces a stable machine-observable outcome and never leaks the sitekey or the response token

acceptanceCriteria.description: A live POST to siteverify with secret=2x0000000000000000000000000000000AA (always-fail secret per https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/troubleshooting/testing/) returns success:false; the pack-fixture /api/submit handler rejects with 400 whose body carries the error-codes value (invalid-input-response) and no sitekey or secret substring.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pack fixture running with the pinned always-fail secret in the environment
acceptanceCriteria.when: a submit hits /api/submit with any response token and the verifier calls siteverify
acceptanceCriteria.then: siteverify returns success:false and the handler responds 400 with an error-codes body and no sitekey leak

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the pack fixture with the injected fetch simulating a siteverify request timeout (fetch rejects with AbortError after the bounded timeout), when a submit hits /api/submit and the verifier calls siteverify, the handler refuses 502 with body {"errorCode":"turnstile.verifier-timeout"}, no downstream handler runs, and exactly one metadata-only audit event fires carrying no response-token or secret substring.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pack fixture running with an injected fetch that rejects with AbortError after the bounded timeout window
acceptanceCriteria.when: a submit hits /api/submit carrying a response token and the verifier calls siteverify
acceptanceCriteria.then: the handler responds 502 with {"errorCode":"turnstile.verifier-timeout"} and one audit event with metadata only

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given an injected fetch that rejects with a network error (ECONNRESET or DNS failure), when the verifier calls siteverify, the handler refuses 502 with body {"errorCode":"turnstile.verifier-network"}, no downstream handler runs, and the audit event carries no response-token or secret substring.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pack fixture with an injected fetch that rejects synchronously with a network error
acceptanceCriteria.then: the handler responds 502 with {"errorCode":"turnstile.verifier-network"} and one metadata-only audit event

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given an injected fetch returning a 500 status body, when the verifier calls siteverify, the handler refuses 502 with body {"errorCode":"turnstile.verifier-upstream", "upstreamStatus":500}, no downstream handler runs.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pack fixture with an injected fetch returning status 500 and any body

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given an injected fetch returning status 200 with a body that is not valid JSON, when the verifier parses the response, the handler refuses 502 with body {"errorCode":"turnstile.verifier-malformed"} and no downstream handler runs.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pack fixture with an injected fetch returning a 200 with a non-JSON body

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given an injected fetch returning valid JSON with no boolean success field (or success set to a non-boolean), when the verifier interprets the response, the handler refuses 502 with body {"errorCode":"turnstile.verifier-malformed"} (fail-closed) and no downstream handler runs.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pack fixture with an injected fetch returning JSON that omits success or supplies a non-boolean value
acceptanceCriteria.then: the handler responds 502 with {"errorCode":"turnstile.verifier-malformed"} and treats the outcome as failure
